fields.meta_title: Security Deposit Form for Landlords | Emergent
fields.meta_description: Create a security deposit form that emails each tenant a receipt and itemizes deductions at move-out, with every deposit on record. Free to start.
fields.h1: Build a Security Deposit Form for Receipts and Returns
fields.hero_description: Build a security deposit form that sends tenants a signed receipt and itemizes every deduction when the lease ends.
fields.features_heading: What the Form Keeps Between Lease and Return
fields.features_subheading: A security deposit form records what the tenant paid at move-in and accounts for every dollar of it when the lease ends.
fields.feature_1:
A receipt the tenant signs on a phone

Enter the amount, the payment method, and the date the deposit arrived. The tenant gets an emailed receipt for that unit and signs it on a phone, and the signed copy stays on file.
fields.feature_2:
One deposit record per unit and lease

Each deposit is saved under its unit and lease, with the tenant's name and the lease end date. Open the unit a year later and the receipt, the amount, and any notes are still there.
fields.feature_3:
Deductions that add up to the refund

List each deduction with a reason and an amount, and the app subtracts the total from the deposit. The statement shows the deposit, every charge, and the refund on a single page.
fields.feature_4:
A photo behind every charge

Attach photos to each deduction from a phone at the final walk-through. Each photo is saved with its line on the statement, and the tenant sees the stained countertop by its charge.
fields.feature_5:
Reminders before each lease ends

Pick how many days before a lease ends the reminder goes out, and who gets it. The property manager receives an email or a Slack message naming the unit and the deposit held on it.
fields.feature_6:
Code you can take with you

Export the app's full code to your GitHub repository on paid plans, and host it wherever your other property tools run. Every deposit record stays in a database you own, by unit.

fields.tab_content_1:
Check logged and receipt signed, all before the keys

Corwin Ashgrove rents the upper unit of his duplex at 27 Tamarack Street to Delphine Okafor. She pays the $1,650 deposit by check at the lease signing, and Corwin records the check on the form. Delphine gets an emailed receipt for the upper unit and signs it on her phone. The signed receipt is saved under that unit.
fields.tab_content_2:
Any lease within 45 days joins the return list

Hollowell Property Management holds deposits on 38 units. Its own rule moves any lease ending within 45 days to the return list. The lease on unit 4C ends in 12 days, and its $1,400 deposit lands on manager Marisol Venn's list with the tenant's forwarding address. The other 37 deposits stay marked Held.
fields.tab_content_3:
Two deductions with photos, then a $995 refund

Rory Vandermeer moved out of his studio at Bellwether Lofts with a $1,200 deposit on file. Leasing agent Noor Halvorsen adds 2 deductions, $120 to patch 3 wall holes and $85 for a broken blind, each with a photo. The statement Rory gets by email shows $205 kept and a $995 refund.
fields.tab_content_4:
One deposit split into three roommate statements

Three roommates at Larkfield Court each paid $900 toward a $2,700 deposit on a three-bedroom unit. At move-out, the only deduction is $210 for a cracked oven door, split evenly at $70 each. Each roommate gets a separate statement by email with a $900 share, the $70 deduction, and an $830 refund.

fields.howto_title: How to Create a Security Deposit Form
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to a security deposit form that issues every receipt and itemizes every refund, built with Emergent.
fields.howto_step_4_title: 04 Match each payment to its tenant
fields.howto_step_1_des: Write down every amount a tenant hands over at the lease signing and who on your side accepts it. Give any separate pet or key deposit its own line, and keep each amount apart from the main deposit on the record.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Before you put amounts or dates on the form, check your state and local rules with an attorney or your local housing agency. Turn what you learn into fields and reminders on the form, instead of notes that live in a drawer.
fields.howto_step_3_des: List the deductions you have charged before, such as patching walls, replacing blinds, or a lost key. Give each a short, plain name that a tenant will recognize on a statement. Require a photo on every line before the statement can go out.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Note the check number or transfer reference with every deposit. A month later, anyone can match the bank statement to the receipt. When two roommates pay separately, record two payments against one deposit, and the receipt lists both.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Put the receipt fields and the deduction lines into one prompt, along with how the return statement should read. Emergent builds the receipt and the statement plus a list of every deposit you hold, with a database behind them. Ask for changes in plain English as your leases change.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Pick who hears about each lease
fields.howto_step_6_des: Choose the lead time for each return to start and the person who owns it. A landlord with one duplex might get an email per unit, while a leasing office posts a weekly list to Slack. Name a backup for vacations.
fields.howto_step_7_des: File a made-up deposit for a test unit, sign the receipt on your own phone, then add 2 deductions with photos. Check that the refund on the statement equals the deposit minus both charges before the form goes to a real tenant.

faq_plan.q: What is a security deposit form?
faq_plan.ref: What is a security deposit form?

prov.original: What is a security deposit form?

faq_plan.a: A security deposit form is the landlord's record of a tenant's deposit. At move-in it serves as the receipt, a written record the landlord provides that shows the amount paid and the date. At move-out, the same record lists any deductions and the refund.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a security deposit form?
faq_plan.a: Write down what you record when a deposit arrives and what you itemize when it goes back. Describe both in one prompt to Emergent's AI form builder. It builds the receipt the tenant signs, the return statement, and a database of every deposit by unit, and you change any field by prompting.

faq_plan.q: What should a security deposit form template include?
faq_plan.a: Start with both parties' names, the property address and unit, the deposit amount, and the payment date and method, plus a line for the tenant's signature. Then add a return section for each deduction and the refund. Before you use any security deposit form template, ask local counsel what else a receipt must show where you rent.

faq_plan.q: Where can I find a free security deposit form?
faq_plan.a: Look for a free security deposit form from a landlord association or your local housing agency. Check it against your local rules before a tenant signs it. A printed security deposit form PDF gives you one signed page at move-in. Emergent is free to start, and the same app can hold the service request form tenants use for repairs.

faq_plan.q: Can a tenant sign a security deposit form on a phone?
faq_plan.a: Yes, if the form asks for a signature. An app built with Emergent can capture the tenant's e-signature on a phone or tablet and save it with the deposit record. Whether an e-signature satisfies a requirement where your rental sits is a question for local rules and counsel.

faq_plan.q: How do I add itemized deductions to a security deposit form template?
faq_plan.a: Give each deduction its own line with a plain description and the amount, then attach a photo of the damage. Total the lines, subtract that total from the deposit, and put the refund at the bottom. Ask local counsel which charges you may deduct and when the statement is due.

faq_plan.q: Can repair records back up deductions on a security deposit form?
faq_plan.a: They can help. A repair the tenant reported through a maintenance request form during the lease gives you a dated record of when the damage was first noted. Keep those requests on the same unit, and the return statement can refer to them beside the matching deduction.

faq_plan.q: Can one security deposit form track deposits across many units?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Keep one record per unit and lease, with the amount held, the lease end date, and the tenant's forwarding address. Sort by end date, and the next returns sit at the top of the list. Emergent puts no response caps on forms, and the list grows with the portfolio.

faq_plan.q: When should a security deposit form ask for a forwarding address?
faq_plan.a: Ask twice: once at move-in as a backup contact, and again when the tenant gives notice. The return statement and any refund need somewhere to go after the keys come back. Check your local rules on how a statement has to be delivered.

faq_plan.q: Should a security deposit form match the lease?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Copy the deposit amount and every tenant's name from the signed lease, and the receipt and the lease will agree. If tenants sign through a rental agreement form, build both in the same app and let the receipt read those fields from the lease.

plan.angle: The top 10 is static paperwork: free receipt templates (Zillow, eForms, AAOA, Domu), two state-agency or association receipt PDFs, and one law firm's itemization letter. Each covers a single moment, either the receipt at move-in or the deductions at move-out, and none keeps the deposit on record in between. This page is for the landlord or property manager building one security deposit form that issues the receipt when the deposit is paid, keeps it on the unit's record, prompts the return before the lease ends, and produces an itemized statement whose deductions add up to the refund, all in a database the landlord owns. No deposit law, deadline or state rule is stated; legal questions point to local rules and counsel.
